native_rule_verbatim: - If you have been transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
Only do this after the agent has clearly indicated that you are being transferred.
bug: Old regex interpreted any transfer/human mention as explicit announcement, including conditional I can transfer offers. Audit found392false mandatory-transfer rejected A1draws and0accepted affected draws; A0no affected draws at audit.
fix: Require explicit affirmative announcement syntax or exact native transfer announcement; exclude conditions, offers and negations. Programmatic enforcement unchanged in scope.
resumption: Completed seed episodes, expansions, suffixes and fixed branch draws reused. Future-partner caches of incomplete suffixes archived because restarted agent suffix may have a different history. Started interrupted requests remain unknown and reserve full estimated cost. All past failed/rejected/wasted call costs charged to same arm and frozen total cap. No temperature, generator prompt, selection, reward, verification or budget-cap changes.
